programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Living in Tuscany allows for the enjoyment of a long truffle season. Rachael shows how to use local truffles to add amazing flavour to a decadent dish of scrambled eggs and potato chips.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: In traditional Taiwanese cuisine, pig liver was regarded as a luxurious ingredient used in nutrition-boosting dishes. Legendary Chef A-fa showcases the gastronomic potential of pig liver.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: Contestants must cook a dish using all nine ingredients in Poh's Everything Mystery Box. The winner scoring themselves $5,000 to spend at Harvey Norman, the bottom three head straight into Pressure Test.

programs.title: 1,000 Ways To Dine
programs.desc: Join Michael Yo as he circles the world for meals that can't, won't and don't stop. Take a ride in a speedy elevator up a thousand feet to the highest revolving restaurant in Canada.

programs.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
programs.desc: Dr. Lee asks Dr. Zoe to help double-team needle-shy Mary Ann's crusty skin. Isaiah's mom is concerned that he is ignoring the large, growing lump over his lower spine.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Join Jason Wang to explore the Pagoda of Once Cut Pork, a renowned Taiwanese dish where Chef Hong Ming skillfully carves pork belly into a delectable, melt-in-your-mouth “pagoda” with precision knife work.

programs.title: Little Girl In The Window
programs.desc: When amateur photographer Iris notices 'HELP' scrawled on a dusty window in a picture she took of a house, she becomes increasingly convinced that the man living there isn't as mild-mannered as he seems.

programs.title: Don't Scream, It's Me
programs.desc: Fifteen years ago, Liz's ex-boyfriend, Drew, was caught robbing a bank. Now, he's in her backyard, asking her to hide him. She agrees to help, but only once her husband is out of the house.

programs.title: Got To Leave Something
programs.desc: Nam-gil and Sang-yoon arrive at the end of Korea, at the beautiful Mihwangsa Temple in Haenam, with a stunning view of the South Sea. They spend a day at the temple, with the head monk.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.desc: When Theresa's mom uncovers a pile of Theresa's childhood memorabilia, it inspires Theresa to do the same in her attic, a room she's too scared to enter.

programs.title: The Mother Flip S1E6 -A Diff-Occult Deal
programs.desc: After backing out of a deal that was too good to be true, Rebecca, Kristy and Roy are $10,000 down and desperate for a win to keep their crews working. They decide to roll the dice on a townhouse.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: Chef Guillaume Brahimi sets a pressure test fit for a king, pushes the contestants to their limits. They need to replicate Guillaume's dish as closely as possible in both looks and taste.
